Georgia. Can you chip in $5?

Derek, the
best leaders of our time are the ones who have visions so big, that when
they proclaim them, you might not believe it can be done. But when you
watch them get to work — you watch them succeed.

Stacey Abrams is exactly that kind of leader.

Over the years, we’ve watched Stacey do what was once seen as
inconceivable.

We watched her lead the Georgia House of Representatives as the first
Black Minority Leader and make real, bipartisan progress for Georgians.

As she fought voter suppression and helped turn Georgia blue for the first
time in a generation.

And we even watched her promote voter participation by getting Oprah to go
knock doors — Oprah!

It’s as simple as this: when Stacey Abrams sees a problem, she solves it.
Period.

But with polls showing us tied with Brian Kemp, we need a flood of
donations to reach out to voters to make sure they know about Stacey’s
record of delivering what was once seen as impossible.

supporters like
you, Derek.
Can you make your
first investment in

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999326:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999327:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999328:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999329:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999330:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999331:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999332:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999333:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60999325:6YJ21mViN:m:1:3334294963:2E5B8A2B36245CD584D03FA4390BBC34:r)

Thank you, Peter.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation</

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Peter. name: Team DLCC
subject: We’ll be honest
body:
The summer slump in August is real, but we can’t lose momentum now | | |
---
| | We’ll be honest with you: Summer slumps are very real when it comes to grassroots fundraising. We get it – it’s August. We know supporters like you are busy. Maybe you’re spending time with loved ones on vacation, getting ready for the upcoming school year, or simply soaking up the final weeks of late sunsets and sunny weather. Election Day might be the furthest thing from your mind right now. **But frankly, Election Day is right around the corner. It’s so critical we hit our August goal and here’s why:** **Donating early ahead of the election will help us finalize our fall budgets, organize volunteers, and conduct vital polling that could mean _the difference between winning and losing on November 8th._** We're in for a tough fight this year. Midterms are never easy for the parties of first-term presidents, and on top of that, we're being outspent by Republicans on the state level. And now that the conservative Supreme Court has gutted key reproductive and environmental rights, there’s even more at stake. **But a tough fight doesn't mean an impossible one. And, with every dollar we raise online, we can be better prepared to elect Democratic candidates for state legislatures across the country this fall.** [Most people don’t pay close attention until November, but you are. Here's something we already know -- _**Democrats LIE!**_ They lied about when they named the "Inflation Reduction Act," and they continue to lie about what's in it. The bill will RAISE taxes on American families -- foolish policy when the economy is in shambles. Here's what the Inflation Reduction Act really does -- **it hires nearly 90,000 new IRS agents** , another instance of the left's misplaced priorities. Our southern border is still in CRISIS, and we should be investing to support our brave Border Patrol Agents, who are on the front lines of Biden's Border Crisis. **[_Instead of hiring more IRS agents to audit more Americans, we should be hiring more Border Patrol Agents to keep our border SAFE AND SECURE!_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61002950:6gAlymVNC:m:1:3331421248:4AFDE0CA65EA6632102F081C194FBBE7:r)** It's not difficult, but somehow it's too difficult for Democrats. August 15, 2022
Dear friend,
Democrats in Shelby County won on August 4th...and they won BIG. Tennessee Voter Project is proud of our endorsed candidates District Attorney-elect Steve Mulroy, Juvenile Court Judge-elect Tarik Sugarmon, Sheriff Floyd Bonner, and Memphis-Shelby County School Board-elect Amber Huett-Garcia, who Shelby County supported loud and clear.
Voters made it clear that they want candidates in office who believe in a fair criminal justice system and justice for victims of violent crime. Voters decided that locking children up and throwing away the key isn't making our community safer, it's harming our children and their families. Voters supported candidates who will invest in our children from the start, particularly in their education and after-school opportunities.
The Tennessee Voter Project [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1] exists to make sure we elect more of these kinds of candidates. We need more candidates in office who are laser-focused on the needs of our community and who prioritize turning out as many voters as possible.

We're excited about the results of the election on August 4th but we've still got work to do. We've got an election coming on November 8th [https://www.electionsshelbytn.gov/elections/state-and-federal-general-bartlett-collierville-germantown-lakeland-and-millington] , where we have the opportunity to elect Democrats at the municipal, state, and federal level. body:
Hi, it's John Fetterman.
You wanna talk about why our elections are so messed up? Let’s start with the number 29... because it tells you everything you need to know.
👉 The average donation to our campaign is $29.
In order to raise all the money it takes to win this race for you + me + PA, we’ve received a mind boggling 582,000 contributions. Now, you might be thinking: ‘Why the hell would John need 582,000 $29 donations?’ Allow me to explain:
👉 A big super PAC called “Senate Leadership Fund” (name sounds really nice, huh?) has booked $29 MILLION+ in TV & radio ads to attack me + boost Dr. Oz.
This advertising onslaught against us starts in THREE DAYS. And as much as I hate to admit it, we know from experience that when super PACs beat people over the head with these stupid 30-second ads... they can drag you down in the polls.
So I’m emailing you today for something entirely predictable... $29. Because we’re behind on our mid-month goal. And, without a whole bunch of you, we aren’t going to be able to push back against this huge negative ad campaign.
So? Can I get $29 (or more or less, it really doesn’t matter) right now so we can meet our $275k mid-month deadline goal? Seriously, every dollar helps when you’re up against this kind of super PAC spending. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220815_CGVA_Fetterman]

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
New Polling in PA-10 has us leading Scott Perry by 4 Points!
I'm thrilled to be writing to you with this exciting news. Last week we polled our race, and the results may surprise you - we're leading my opponent, Scott Perry by 4 points - 14% to 45%. We're even winning 17% of likely Republican voters!
More than that, Scott Perry is underwater on favorability, with just 40% of likely voters having a favorable opinion of my opponent.
The bottom line is this, we CAN win this race. We ARE winning this race. Now we need make it happen.
First, I would like to say a big thank you to supporters like you. You helped us get to this point and we are grateful. The fact of the matter is we won't get across the finish line without your continued support.
CAN YOU MAKE A CONTRIBUTION NOW GET US TO THE NEXT STEP? DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
While many will find this result surprising, they shouldn’t. Whether Scott Perry betrayed our country is up to authorities to decide, but he has betrayed his constituents and they know it.
Voters in PA-10 are sick and tired of extremist, violent rhetoric and the politics of division represented by Scott Perry. They are ready to elect leaders who are going to listen to them and fight for them on the issues that matter. My opponent doesn’t even respect their vote, much less their voice. He is more concerned with Donald Trump’s needs than those of the people he was elected to represent, and they have had enough.
I became an attorney and member of City Council because I wanted to help people, and that’s why I’m running for Congress. In my career in both politics and the law, I’ve learned that we aren’t all going to agree on everything. Our elected leaders need to work to bring our communities together on the difficult issues we face and get results. It’s hard work, but that’s what I’ve done on City Council, and that’s what I’ll do in Congress.
THIS IS MAKE OR BREAK TIME FOR OUR CAMPAIGN. WILL YOU STEP UP TO HELP US MAKE THIS VICTORY A REALITY? - DONATE NOW! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/PaidForByDanielsForCongressB.jpg]
Daniels For Congress

Harrisburg, PA 17102

---
| |
---
| | Peter,

What do the Minnesota Game Fair, Public TV (Almanac), the Minnesota Chamber of Commerce, and the Rochester Chamber of commerce all have in common? Well, they're **all** organizations that have offered debates/forums and were declined by Tim Walz. He doesn't want to talk about his record or the [exploding crime trends](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=d3edf71065&e=33b11688c1) in Minnesota under him.

Tim Walz is dodgin', duckin', and letting big-money groups do his dirty work in demonizing Matt Birk and me. **You've probably heard about the TV ads running already** ; [can you give $50, $150, $250, or more this morning to help us combat them and get up on TV ourselves?](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=0210f98e8a&e=33b11688c1)

Watch my response video below to Tim Walz's "Biden Basement" strategy. [**Click the thumbnail below:**](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=99d077f5cb&e=33b11688c1)
---
| [ ](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=2e27942ffb&e=33b11688c1)
---
| Peter, I don't mean to beat a dead horse - but Tim Walz has 10x the cash our campaign has. The DFL machine is now up and running, and they'll ruthlessly attack our campaign with potentially tens of millions of dollars behind them! There are 84 days until Election Day and **_only 39 days until early voting starts_**. [We need help right now to "fill the coffers"](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=47c2f03c6c&e=33b11688c1) and combat the heinous TV messages these groups are putting out!

We know we have the winning message, a capable team, and the will of the PEOPLE are behind this campaign - but we need the resources to compete, or Tim Walz is going to "stay in the basement" and try to buy a victory in this election! Please pray about giving this morning and know that your hard-earned money will be used in the following ways should you choose to help:
* [$25 will help us hire more field staff to do door knocking](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=4cf3f985bb&e=33b11688c1)
* [$75 will help us do targeted direct mailers to swing voters](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=11987816d4&e=33b11688c1)
* [$150 will help us run digital streaming ads to combat the DFL Machine](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=121526c16e&e=33b11688c1)
* [$500 or more will help us fund television ads, which are extremely expensive](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=200733eb0d&e=33b11688c1)

Every-day people fuel our campaign! We're not taking money from big tech or big pharma - and that puts an even bigger target on our backs. **Today I ask:** will you start your week by helping us combat the massive money gap in this election?

This race is a toss up! [Help us continue this momentum!](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=a22cdc5f1b&e=33b11688c1)

Thank you.
---
|
In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for Governor - Minnesota

body:
Could you please take a few minutes to complete our campaign's first general election priorities survey?
| | |
---
Peter,

I’m Trudy Busch Valentine: a nurse, mother, children’s advocate, proud fourth-generation Missourian, and, **as of a few weeks ago, your Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Missouri.** I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running to do the same thing in Washington. I hope you’ll just take a moment to read about what’s at stake and why I'm in this race.
As a young girl growing up in Missouri, I watched my parents live the American Dream. They always told me, “To whom much is given, much is expected.” That sense of obligation to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service.

It’s why I volunteered as a candy striper when I was only 13 years old. It’s what led me to attend nursing school, work in hospitals, and later, work for the Salvation Army.
It’s also why I’ve decided to run for U.S. Senate;** Missourians deserve a senator who will put politics aside, put people first, and work to make sure that everyone is able to live out the American Dream. Now, as we head into the general election, I need to hear from top Democratic supporters like you, Peter. **
[**So I'm asking a favor: Could you please take a few minutes to complete our campaign's first general election priorities survey? Your feedback is essential to helping me understand where to focus our efforts so that we can develop a winning strategy for November.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49257099/361452771/-2043110283?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk175-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MDAyYjkwNS1iNDFjLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Mj8piV6Cgm4orXdBTSO-omnookev4Hjb3nol15Sb2JE=&emci=1c888603-2d17-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=5002b905-b41c-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)

I've been fortunate in life. I’ve never had to fight to get the healthcare I need. I’ve never seen an eviction notice on my door. I’ve never worried about paying my electric bill.

But too many Missourians have.
These days, the American Dream seems to come with a price tag – and that price is way too high. That’s why I’m ready to help lower the cost of basic necessities. I’m ready to expand access to affordable healthcare. I’m ready to fight for a person’s right to choose. And I’m ready to put an end to our state’s tragic opioid epidemic.
Peter, we’ve known for too long that Washington is broken, with leaders dividing rather than uniting us. Missourians know that we need more compassion and less politics. To truly solve problems, we need leadership that puts politics aside and puts people first – and that’s exactly what I’m ready to do as your next U.S. senator.
**But look: I believe leaders should talk less and listen more – and that’s why I’m reaching out to you as we kick off this campaign.[This is our campaign’s very first general election priorities survey, and your answers today will help guide the strategy to fix a broken Washington and rebuild our great state. I’d be so grateful for your input.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49257101/361452800/-2043110283?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk175-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MDAyYjkwNS1iNDFjLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Mj8piV6Cgm4orXdBTSO-omnookev4Hjb3nol15Sb2JE=&emci=1c888603-2d17-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=5002b905-b41c-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**
While working in the hospital, I cared for children, seniors, and people from all walks of life. It’s also where I learned the importance of quality healthcare. As a nurse, I believe that every person deserves access to the very best medical care, and as a parent, I believe that every person should have access to contraception and abortion care – full stop.
Now that the Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade, we're in an uncertain and scary time. **We don’t know what will happen next, but here’s what I do know: You can count on me to fight for the rights of ALL Missourians.**
But I can only run a winning campaign if grassroots input is at the center of our strategy. **[So, Peter, will you help start the general election strong by responding to our priorities survey? Your opinion means a lot to me.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49257102/361452801/-2043110283?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk175-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MDAyYjkwNS1iNDFjLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Mj8piV6Cgm4orXdBTSO-omnookev4Hjb3nol15Sb2JE=&emci=1c888603-2d17-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=5002b905-b41c-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**

name: Great America Update
subject: Learn How America Can Prosper Again
body:
We’ve done something new. We’ve created a free online teaching series that combines the learning of an online course with the features of a documentary. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6244%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=aY7Xc%2bEeIq4XN69484zBRg&sysid=1)
| This sponsored message from Great American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75505%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8H313kDz474babB54mrxgg&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear Friend, We’ve done something new.

We’ve created a free online teaching series that combines the learning of an online course with the features of a documentary.

That’s why when you watch the trailer for our newest free online teaching series, “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ,” you’ll notice that your professor, Dr. Laffer, is accompanied by Larry Kudlow, Steve Forbes, Amity Shlaes, and others. Together they explain the fascinating history of economics in America and what is required to restore economic freedom and prosperity to our great nation.

I’d like you to be one of the first people to preview this new series. **You can watch your video and pre-register for the new series below:**
---
| | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75506%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LBU4q4s13OBbnP8YDcDkZw&sysid=1)
---
In this free teaching series, Presidential Medal of Freedom recipient Arthur Laffer--famous for the Laffer Curve and for advising President Ronald Reagan--provides answers to fundamental questions about the core areas of macroeconomics--taxation, money, government spending, regulation, and trade--and how government policies in these areas either promote or hinder the growth of the economy.

In each episode, you’ll learn from Dr. Laffer, as well as:

* **Steve Forbes** , Chairman and Editor-in-Chief of Forbes Media.
* **Stephen Moore** , distinguished fellow in economics at the Heritage Foundation and author, with Art Laffer, of Trumponomics: Inside the America First Plan to Revive Our Economy.
* **Brian Domitrovic** , economic historian and author of Econoclasts: The Rebels Who Sparked the Supply-Side Revolution and Restored American Prosperity.
* **Larry Kudlow** , former Director of the National Economic Council under President Donald Trump.
* **Amity Shlaes** , chair of the board of the Calvin Coolidge Presidential Foundation and best-selling author of The Forgotten Man: A New History of the Great Depression.
* And, **Larry P. Arnn** , President of Hillsdale College.

This free series could not be timelier, given our current economic situation. In this free series, you’ll learn how private citizens drive the economy and you’ll discover the role economic incentives play in unleashing prosperity--timeless lessons in human nature and economics that are common sense to most Americans, but appear lost on many in our academic and political “elite.”

**[So, after watching the trailer, I hope you’ll be one of the first to join us by pre-registering for this free online series.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75507%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VIMWSe%2bBBswVBhIB7zF93g&sysid=1)**

Americans across the country like you are looking for answers to our current economic condition. But, as Dr. Art Laffer explains, good economic policy is not complicated, and you can learn why.

Pre-register for “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ” today!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** There’s one more thing: After you pre-register, will you also consider giving a special tax-deductible gift to help promote “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ” to millions of Americans nationwide?

Your generous gift will help us promote this course and our other educational efforts, like _Imprimis_ and our classical K-12 education programs.

As you may know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding--even indirectly in the form of federal or state student loans and grants. That means this series and everything else we do here is only possible because of our generous supporters.

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supply-side-economics-preregister](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75508%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=otk0WHl6ArJy3VWGrktFGQ&sysid=1)**
---
_107 S West St. #826, Alexandria VA 22314_
_[Unsubscribe](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/OptOut.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6244%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=aY7Xc%2bEeIq4XN69484zBRg&sysid=1)_

[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/CB.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6244%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=aY7Xc%2bEeIq4XN69484zBRg&sysid=1)

###### _A Message from..._
##### John Philip Sousa IV
###### National Chairman of Stars & Stripes Forever PAC
###### _Formerly the 2016 Committee and National Draft Ben Carson for President Committee_
| Dear Peter, Will they ever stop attacking President Trump? Don't they care that there are pressing matters that demand their attention such as the economy, inflation and Ukraine? By now, you likely have learned about the FBI's unprecedented raid on President Trump's Mar-a-Lago residence. The FBI defended its raid by saying it was connected to an ongoing Department of Justice (DOJ) probe into whether Donald Trump kept classified government documents after departing the White House in January 2021. Biden claims he did not know about the raid beforehand... **Really? The DOJ is led by Biden appointed Attorney General Merrick Garland.** President Trump does not believe Biden and neither do conservatives like us. We believe that the FBI's search was an effort by President Biden's administration to target a political opponent. Another witch hunt. |
---
You and I agree with President Trump. This raid was indeed 100% political and Biden and his far left gang of political cronies are pulling out all the stops to make sure that Biden stays in the White House.
It's obvious that neither Puppet Biden, nor his puppeteers, care about us. They only care about increasing and holding on to their political power.
Biden and the Democrats are using taxpayer money and his presidential influence to go after the one person they fear most in the 2024 Presidential election. Biden knows the public does not have confidence in him as he watches his approval rating plummet to the lower 30s...

subject: Thank you! On to November.
body:
I'm grateful for your support. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/philscott/thank-you-on-to-november-ljf47lm8jl?e=19cebfe173)
---
| |
---
| | , I’m grateful to have made it through last week's primary, and I thank each and every person who supported me. I also want to commend all who stepped up to run and congratulate those who were successful on Tuesday. It’s not easy to put yourself out there in order to help make Vermont a better place. I went into this Primary knowing the big-ticket races on the Democratic ballot would impact turnout on the Republican ballot. So, I want to thank those who’ve stuck by my side over the last six years and the thousands of Vermonters who kindly wrote me in for the Democratic nomination, regardless of partisan affiliation. While the outcomes of some of the races were surprising, our success shows that Vermonters are still truly independent in spirit. Vermonters want leaders that - regardless of partisan politics - treat others with dignity and respect, listen to their concerns, and work to do the right thing, even when it’s difficult and not politically popular. As I look ahead to the general election, I’ll do what I’ve always done by running a positive, issues-based campaign - talking with Vermonters about the things that matter most and working every day to grow the economy, make Vermont more affordable, and protect the vulnerable. Every campaign is about choices, and this year is no different. With worldwide inflation and economic uncertainty, it’s never been more important to have a seasoned team and a steady hand at the wheel. Thank you again for your support and for proving that Vermonters value leadership that puts principle ahead of politics. On to November, Phil

name: Andy Kim
subject: This bill will be a game-changer
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
The House just passed the Inflation Reduction Act, and now the bill is heading to President Biden's desk for his signature.

This bill is a game-changer on so many levels.

I came to Congress in 2019 on the promise to fight for working families, lower health costs and protect those with pre-existing conditions. Today, we deliver on that promise.

Here's what it does:

➡️ Caps out-of-pocket prescription drug costs to $2,000 per year or $166 per month. So many seniors struggle to pay for the high cost of medication. This will cap that cost so they don't have to choose which medications they can afford. I have fought for and co-wrote this provision, and I'm thrilled to see it become the law.

➡️ Empowers Medicare to negotiate drug prices. Big Pharma fought hard to keep this from passing – that tells you all you need to know. We are finally giving Medicare the negotiating power they need to bring down the costs of drugs for Medicare recipients.

➡️ Caps insulin costs at $35/month for seniors on Medicare. I voted to cap insulin at $35/month for every American, but Senate Republicans stripped it from the bill. This will be a huge help for those on Medicare, and I will keep fighting for a cap on insulin costs for ALL Americans.

The Inflation Reduction Act is also the most significant investment in addressing the climate crisis in our nation's history, boosting clean energy production, reducing greenhouse gas emissions by 40% over the next decade, and creating millions of good-paying jobs here in America. It will help lower costs today, while shifting to cleaner sources of American energy in the future.

Finally, it provides real tax reform to ensure ultra-wealthy corporations pay their fair share — and makes a big dent in reducing the deficit and easing inflation.

This bill delivers some much-needed relief and progress for New Jersey families. More work is needed, but this bill is a great step forward.

Andy

Folks, **[I’m going to ask you to chip in toward our campaign’s important mid-quarter fundraising goal in just a moment.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49260723/361468643/-2090294366?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_GEN_MQG_AC_20220815_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjJiYzljYy1iZDFjLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TXyP3iCvOHEvRWyCFjobdsCrbrD7G4byRIWX_Eefk3c=)** But first I want to share why your contribution makes a difference in our work for New Mexicans and folks across the country. My dad was an immigrant, union lineman, and my mom was a factory worker: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49260724/361468644/-2090294366?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_GEN_MQG_AC_20220815_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjJiYzljYy1iZDFjLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TXyP3iCvOHEvRWyCFjobdsCrbrD7G4byRIWX_Eefk3c=) My parents taught me that anything should be possible in our country as long as you work hard and play by the rules. That philosophy guides my work every day. It’s why I fought so hard to get the _Inflation Reduction Act_ across the finish line. This bill will help even the playing field for Americans — reducing prescription drug prices, making corporations pay their fair share, and putting money back in people’s pockets who electrify their homes and vehicles to do right by our planet. My parents’ guidance is also why our campaign puts so much time and effort into electing strong Democrats up and down the ballot. Our majorities in Congress and the White House have delivered the _Inflation Reduction Act_ and the American Rescue Plan. But we also need leaders at the state and local level who will secure what their communities and our planet need. Our state and local leaders are at the front lines of our fights to boost the economy, protect reproductive rights, and preserve our lands and waters for future generations. body:
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us...
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z216e9akecs8djkjps2sk2l216ragk9p1u0r8f68_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sr4m1pm8p37ckq70p326hgb5crje9ob3crh6thmasr0e6rradpjmeqb6o32m1oefkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup70phhmsqj1ptmcdj39o5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6o35c3i60pj2c8iv0)
| | | [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zlv0k7iribgo6f3hcohuiclbea2scscac5ri7aa0_rp22sh2s8i66or0clge8o36c9h2bs)
---
|
---
Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? | | Peter, Five years ago, an ugly mix of Neo-Nazis and Klansmen invaded Charlottesville, Virginia under the "Unite the Right" banner. They carried tiki-torches and Confederate flags. They chanted racist, antisemitic slogans. And one of their members drove his car into a crowd of anti-racist counter-protestors, killing one and injuring dozens more. In response to this awful tragedy, President Trump refused to disavow the violence in Charlottesville that day, insisting "there were very fine people on both sides." And the most troubling part for me, Peter? **Charlottesville was only the beginning of the recent rise of hatred and far-right violence, stoked by Donald Trump and his enablers.** In the years since Charlottesville, hundreds of local far-right militia groups have popped up across the country. The Proud Boys. Oath Keepers. Patriot Prayer. Three Percenters. This dangerous list keeps growing. And although these groups have different names, they all share a racist, fascist agenda. **Unfortunately, we've seen this type of violent extremism right here in Oregon.** In December of 2020, with the aid of a Republican state legislator, a group of far-right protesters successfully breached our capitol building in Salem. They were met promptly by Salem police and state troopers who repelled the rioters and whose bravery that day prevented a possible tragedy. About two weeks later, the same kinds of rioters would mount an insurrection at the United States capitol. The scenes from that day are still chilling to watch. **Peter, this is what we're up against.** The unthinkable has become our new reality, as extremist groups look to push their radical agenda on all of us. Here's the good news, Peter: these groups haven't won. They do not represent the majority of Americans. But we must remain vigilant. **And you can be sure that our campaign will stand with you every step of the way as we combat bigotry in all its forms.** Thanks for standing with us as we fight hatred body:
Don't miss Crystal's event with Dallas Goldtooth and other Water Protectors weighing in on the proposed permitting reforms. |
# Mecou (Hello)
---
The Inflation Reduction Act has passed the Senate and House. As frontline Water Protectors, we have mixed feelings. We embrace the components of the bill that work towards climate emissions reductions and support communities to transition out of extractive industries. At the same time, we find it unacceptable that any supposed climate legislation would promote and advance the fossil fuel industry. **** We’re hearing that Manchin’s permitting reform measures, which would fast-track the MVP and benefit pipeline projects into the future, are slated to be tagged onto a must-pass government funding bill that will be voted on in late September. **** **In order to show massive public opposition, we are mobilizing Water Protectors and frontline communities to unite, rally and lobby in DC on September 8th.**[ Save the date and sign up here to be an MVP Resistance Volunteer.](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnn2H0La_yXIpyATgV_97-8ci81pnyniJ8xhhnx9OW0NXxiKGfpAptpsxOrh7khmDO7XrtVR_Ci9Y0gwD3r2LhLSIIsMKGZapUjzeJ__0PZQAl9jckZOLYvTKLCe1oY09en9664qCCQwYLguWe2rq2e_cO2f3ymKXpHjU5AqkoVNPdlS_b7Rn6_HWweYcfohYyatJ3GzABBVo4RLVL7ZWO7uIcFJ2va-QJowQ0XTIhAYDs62e3g7EA-TQ-7OaOHG8xSx4UQFpEYrkmwzlOoIhRq_C5k3zvYTR_fvh3V138GZnQPl7wiQx3hnArtSlutn5zE/3om/RhREfPy8RsWSDmlyEkKhBQ/h0/EdOYxE5kVlOtZ-DXP9f2mtisBLtEFr-3f3wOD-ANCZY)

clean_body: Don't miss Crystal's event with Dallas Goldtooth and other Water Protectors weighing in on the proposed permitting reforms. | Mecou (Hello) The Inflation Reduction Act has passed the Senate and House. As frontline Water Protectors, we have mixed feelings. We embrace the components of the bill that work towards climate emissions reductions and support communities to transition out of extractive industries. At the same time, we find it unacceptable that any supposed climate legislation would promote and advance the fossil fuel industry. ** We’re hearing that Manchin’s permitting reform measures, which would fast-track the MVP and benefit pipeline projects into the future, are slated to be tagged onto a must-pass government funding bill that will be voted on in late September. In order to show massive public opposition, we are mobilizing Water Protectors and frontline communities to unite, rally and lobby in DC on September 8th. | Take Action NOW! to attend a Community Strategy Call with 7 Directions on either Tues 8/16 or Thurs 8/18 (Zoom links to follow) Individuals: sign this Organizations: sign this Share the | Don't miss this conversation. | | Join us for these co-learning & community building events Bila:huk (Thank You) | | | Sent via . body:

| | | | |

| | | | | Peter, **From the response we’ve been getting, it seems like a lot of you don’t want Sarah Palin back in your political news feed for the next two years, either.** [**Have you had a chance to support Palin’s strongest opponent, Mary Peltola, in the race for Alaska’s open congressional seat? Any amount will help.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T69364d85-9d03-4d7b-974d-74d1a4467ccf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump, the twice impeached Republican President--both times for betraying our national security--is being investigated under the Espionage Act for stealing classified documents and storing them among the bedbugs, sycophants and spies at Mar-a-Lago. So here comes Sarah Palin, who's run out of reality shows, cheap gimmicks and family values (her husband Todd divorced her a few years ago, accusing her of abuse), reentering a political system she helped debase in 2008 with her casual stupidity and endless conspiracies. [**Can you please join me in supporting Mary Peltola with $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford, and rejecting the hate and lies, once again, of Sarah Palin?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta3a934ab-5636-4178-91a4-7797de691ecb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Palin's running for the vacant seat in Congress from Alaska. She was joined by Trump at a rally the very day Mar-a-Lago was raided, and put out the following crass, dishonest and riot-inciting statement (See FBI Building, Cincinnati) in response to the FBI raid to retrieve stolen state secrets----including some on nuclear technology--that Trump may have been selling to our enemies:** _**If Palin wins the seat from Alaska, she'll have the large soapbox afforded her by her fame from which to attack our democracy and institutions, weakening the rule of law. It would be like taking Marjorie Taylor Greene or Lauren Boebert and injecting them with steroids. In a few words, Sarah Palin's uniquely dangerous.**_ **Luckily we have a GREAT CHANCE to stop Palin and win this seat. Alaska has a top four primary and a ranked choice general election ballot. Native Alaskan and Democrat Mary Peltola is running for the seat, and if Democrats list her first, and she's listed second on enough ballots by independents and Republicans angry at the other Republicans for attacking their top choice, she can win!**

name: Laurie Teper
subject: Immediate Need!
body:
Hey Team,
Are you willing to take _one hour of your time_ to make some phone calls to people who should have received the fundraiser invitation in the mail? We have already seen a big difference in responses since we started calling. Many said they didn't see one, so this is a great opportunity to tell them about the events! Please contact your County Coordinator for access to the sheets.Their emails are listed below. It's a live sheet so you can write notes on it (left message, yes coming, no not coming, etc) so people can see who you have called. _Any questions at all, call, email or text me or contact your county coordinator. We are here to help!_

It's a simple friendly conversation.

"Hi, my name is ___________________ calling on behalf of Courtney Geels who is running for US Congress. Did you receive her invitation to the ________________County Fundraiser Dinner at _(location_) on (_date_)? If yes, are you planning to attend? Did you RSVP? Do you know anyone else who would join you?" If they didn't receive one, give them the information and website <https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/events/> to purchase tickets. Tell them there is one happening in each county throughout August and into September at some really nice venues so if they cannot attend one, choose another one. The events are listed below

**Person County** \- 4 days from today!

| | Dear Fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...

subject: Week of August 15th CTA: November is coming – help with Election Integrity!
body:
| | | |
---
---
Congress is out for the next four weeks (thankfully!), so while they’re out, there are other types of actions we can take to make a difference for our country.
---
|
---
[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-5un99CVJkEFHHiv8Q)
---
** URGENT: SIGN UP TO BE POLL WORKER OR WATCHER** As you may know, the main focus of Tea Party Patriots Action since the 2020 election has been election integrity. **Much of election integrity depends on honest patriots like you signing up as poll workers and poll watchers.** In nearly every county in the U.S., most these positions have historically been held by left-wing activists. If we are not a part of the process, we cannot ensure there is honesty and integrity in the system. If you’re wondering which is better, poll worker (also called election worker, officer of election, election judge, etc. in different places) is preferable. Poll watchers are much more limited in what they are able to do, while workers have actual power to make decisions that matter, in most cases. And they get paid a lot of the time! So, if you have a choice, it is better to be a worker than a watcher, but being a watcher is better than nothing! Deadlines are fast approaching for the November election, so please sign up today! The [**U.S. Election Assistance Commission has a handy tool**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMjctMTIwNWU2Nzg3YmZjNDY3YjgyN2E3YWRmYjliOGQ1YzEiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmVhYy5nb3YvaGVscC1hbWVyaWNhLXZvdGU_bWlkPTQ1NjcwJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/ZmqeJdVqVLPH5SLT-9qJHA) to find out how to become a poll worker/watcher in your state and county. Just scroll down to the **Poll Worker Recruitment Lookup Tool** and select your state. They also have [**a document that lists all of the requirements for serving as a poll worker**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-aSFsCjyMQ2xkLA) on a state-by-state basis, so you can use that to see if you meet the requirements. Also, many states allow teenagers (i.e. 16 and up) to serve as poll workers or watchers, so if you know any high-schoolers who would want to serve in this way, invite them to sign up too! **One last note:[Watch my speech at CPAC](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMjctMTIwNWU2Nzg3YmZjNDY3YjgyN2E3YWRmYjliOGQ1YzEiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMyIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8veW91dHUuYmUvUEk5ckgtbTJyQWc_bWlkPTQ1NjcwJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/QEaGzIbIUk65pS94C9qNvQ) where I discuss election integrity and how important it is!**
---
| | |
---
| | [Radical politicization](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-4anEecvfvSWi7f7qQWTw) of the law enforcement community, from state and local police forces all the way up to the FBI and the [Department of Justice](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), is leaving Americans vulnerable. Just recently, New York Governor Kathy Hochel signed a bill, backed by Albany Democrats, that will replace the word “inmate” with “incarcerated person” in state law to be more politically correct. Meanwhile, shootings in her city spiked 13.4% last month alongside a 34.4% increase in murder since July 2021, a clear sign that Hochel’s partisan priorities are misplaced. With so much woke virtue signaling within the prison system, it’s no wonder that a stampede of New York police officers are voluntarily [quitting](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-8K8sNgai-1dv3wa2nDvg) their positions before reaching full pension eligibility. Even the mainstream media has [acknowledged](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-7uVvdpMd7yBGp2iXFGbw) the reality that America is running short on cops, a phenomenon [caused by](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) the left-wing attacks on local police and sheriffs’ departments. Citizens who call 911 are less likely to receive timely officer reinforcement, leading many to [purchase](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-b5Yjjg) handguns for personal safety.
---
| | |
---
[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
**PRE-ORDER DINESH D’SOUZA’S BOOK,_2000 MULES_** Many of you have watched _2000 Mules_ the documentary, and the book will be out August 30th. Pre-order the book now – buy it for yourself, friends who may have not heard about what happened, donate it to the library, etc. Help get the word out! Order on [Amazon](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), [Books-A-Million](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), [Books & Company](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMjctMTIwNWU2Nzg3YmZjNDY3YjgyN2E3YWRmYjliOGQ1YzEiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMTMiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5ib29rc2NvLmNvbS9ib29rLzk3ODE2ODQ1MTA4MzI_bWlkPTQ1NjcwJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/vWaHah6uHguUAn3ciV0U-Q), [Barnes & Noble](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), and others. The audio version is also available for pre-order at [Barnes & Noble](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.).
---
|
---
| | [New polling](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._QV0Gv8Xyw) shows that if American patriots fail to cast their ballot this November, they risk losing an opportunity to recapture the majority in the midterm election. The Republican Party is now trailing, losing its year-long lead over the Democrats in generic-ballot polls, according to [FiveThirtyEight](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyMjctMTIwNWU2Nzg3YmZjNDY3YjgyN2E3YWRmYjliOGQ1YzEiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMTciLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2FyY2hpdmUucGgvYUNSUWI_bWlkPTQ1NjcwJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/Jbqr7bLBP3B1WDCF0jjcXA). Democrats have a 59% chance of holding their Senate majority, the analysis of several polls concluded. But most of the polling was conducted prior to, or amid the FBI’s raid on President Trump’s Mar-a-Lago home. A poll conducted since the raid shows that [more than 80% of Republican respondents](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._iwEgkLUOouOUPADbA9Q) said it made them more motivated to vote in this year’s midterm election. Historically, the generic ballot has overestimated Democratic performance. Actual elections are fought district-by-district and state-by-state, and the generic ballot does not account for that reality. In deep blue Oregon, for example, recent [polling](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._QBxKSlcq36QlzA) reveals tight races for House seats traditionally safe for Democrats. The generic polls may serve as a helpful wakeup call for complacent patriots. Democrats are not about to hand victory over to the Republicans. In the end, it all boils down to which side works harder to turn out the vote.
---
| | [](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-1iNdQ)
---
**JOIN YOUR STATE’S ELECTION INTEGRITY TEAM** Another great way to ensure elections are honest, transparent, and fair is to join your state’s election integrity team if one already exists, or to start one if it doesn’t already exist. If you are interested in building out permanent election integrity infrastructure in your state and in your county, [**please fill out this form**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), and we will be in touch with you. In the states and counties where these exist, we are already seeing a difference in the integrity of the election and the results. We just learned that the Senate Leadership Fund – a Mitch McConnell-aligned super PAC – has already reserved **$34 MILLION** in ads in Pennsylvania.

name: Harriet Hageman
subject: Pelosi’s favorite republican: Liz Cheney
body:
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zr4bmj30sqag3com1o5ldf9senerb9569p4f6vsg_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieaob5cph2bs)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvln0kt2ajjidr6d4s4dtlb8f2soo6n95orsa6n0_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieaob5cph2bs)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_ .

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zk0o5fje7n99q5i37h23mu381ga7iofo2qjllrao_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieaob5cph2bs)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z23mcpsf9dvh14258v32bcmap2sdashkh42kr3ko_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieaob5cph2bs)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zn2qa08ml6tvvm46kldgir339ipgv0pes9onpo18_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieaob5cph2bs) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgvar74qb5se5cp8rpjc3c2kgh8bth43v4n6b4io_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieaob5cph2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

But for this email, we’ll let the vote-suppressing extremists do the talking. Here are some quotes from the far-right on redistricting and voting rights: *“I guess I really actually feel we shouldn’t contort the voting process to accommodate the urban — read African-American — voter-turnout machine.” - Doug Preisse, Franklin County Republican Party *“I don’t want everyone to vote.” - Paul Weyrich, Heritage Foundation *“If you look at the statistics, African American voters are voting in just as high a percentage as Americans." - Mitch McConnell, Senate Minority Leader *"We are in the business of rigging elections.”- Mark McDaniel, North Carolina State Senator *“Republicans should look out for Republicans when drawing the lines for reapportionment.” - Alex Triantafilou, Hamilton County Republican Party Are these the kinds of people that you want drawing maps and or making election laws? body:
The number 29 seriously tells you everything you need to know about this race.
#
You wanna talk about why our elections are so messed up, Derek? Let’s start with the number 29... because it tells you everything you need to know.
**👉 The average donation to our campaign is $29.**
In order to raise all the money it takes to win this race for you + me + PA, we’ve received a mind boggling 582,000 contributions. Now, you might be thinking: ‘Why the hell would John need 582,000 $29 donations?’ Allow me to explain:
** 👉 A big super PAC called “Senate Leadership Fund” (name sounds really nice, huh?) has booked $29 MILLION+ in TV & radio ads to attack me + boost Dr. Oz.**
Derek, this advertising onslaught against us starts THIS WEEK. And as much as I hate to admit it, we know from experience that when super PACs beat people over the head with these stupid 30-second ads... they can drag you down in the polls.
**So I’m emailing you today for something entirely predictable... $29.** Because we’re behind on our mid-month goal, which ends at midnight tonight. And, without a whole bunch of you, we aren’t going to be able to push back against this huge negative ad campaign.
[**_So, Derek? Can I get $29 (or more or less, it really doesn’t matter) right now so we can meet our $275k mid-month deadline goal before 11:59 p.m. tonight? Seriously, every dollar helps when you’re up against this kind of super PAC spending._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220815-1?refcode=em20220815-6865&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6865_434096_oIRNEi&akid=6865%2E434096%2EoIRNEi)
**[Contribute $29](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220815-1?refcode=em20220815-6865&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6865_434096_oIRNEi&akid=6865%2E434096%2EoIRNEi)**
It shouldn’t be this way.
You shouldn’t have to be a gazillionaire like Dr. Oz to run for office.
You shouldn’t have super PACs spending $29 MILLION to sink good candidates with ridiculous (and may I add, false) 30-second ads.
But, until we get to the Senate and fight for real campaign finance reform, this is the world we live in. And the only way I know how to beat the Big Money is by energizing as many of YOU as possible to chip in $29 at a time.
**We’ve got less than 3 months left, and the attacks are going to get worse and worse from here on out.** [**_If you can, please help us reach that $275k mid-month goal by midnight so we don’t fall behind + so we can compete toe to toe with the giant super PACs._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220815-1?refcode=em20220815-6865&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6865_434096_oIRNEi&akid=6865%2E434096%2EoIRNEi)
Me + Gisele + our whole team are so grateful to each and every one of you. It’s because of all our grassroots donors and volunteers and supporters that we have a fighting chance to go up against all that big money and WIN.
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220815-6865-footer&t=1&refcode2=6865_434096_oIRNEi&akid=6865%2E434096%2EoIRNEi)**
