name: Harriet Hageman
subject: Will you help me fire Pelosi’s #1 Republican ally?
body:
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zn6lvce7v9jii674vfm3l121qi73fdj2e4hbj4ag_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkeq32t5nmeq33cjl61qn4cdkmoq37c3nm6or9ctn6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfbcpi6hi72d3gmco66p3j65omfc5jcjim4plnmeqr5c7563i6acb3e5hbbchj6srt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9o6ccdkmkqjfclicoor1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdhm0pb4sth64pb24no)
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z4c2qronibok9v7hpvbivpvses0i325bhtfd00so_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieeoj2clh2bs)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zmuhq33kgg06sobutopa9nah54uilgg736bscmf0_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieeoj2clh2bs)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_ .

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zcj1sh3o6bst8ggesm6ici7ipap6tnr8j39lu460_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieeoj2clh2bs)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2ztrjqss9ogp6maoara85afc96vc49as5pa5k9pio_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieeoj2clh2bs)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z90lc2ehtkn9hvbftbeorvt97uh1jotk00vfj4h8_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieeoj2clh2bs) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zbk08nooagsevu630d4ftgl1fuonosn3uq02o03o_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieeoj2clh2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

PS: Remember – Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me.

[**Will you help me prove that by sending her packing with a $35 or more campaign donation to my primary challenge?**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z90a3ju3cf9mvbr3141l3gvr4prdop27p4hgbb3g_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieeoj2clh2bs)

[DONATE](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z8f7mrvfljqhcs1p9dgndrgjmf81ajrhc85r8tho_rp22sh2s8i66or0clieeoj2clh2bs)

The stakes in the Attorney General’s race are incredibly high for Georgians, and we need to be able to amplify our outreach at all levels for the remaining 12 weeks of this campaign. **That's why meeting tonight's fundraising deadline is critical.**

**[Please, will you chip in $10 today to ensure that we meet our goal? We're just $3,057 away from meeting it, and anything you can give will help us cross the finish line.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49260890/361469075/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_220815MMD1_MMD_FA_FULL_10_NG_N_L1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDJiYzljYy1iZDFjLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=npYwEB4AHBOjvhbxsxxbVrFLHBinDieFOfzZ5aRspN8=)**

Felicia Agostini
Deputy Campaign Manager

_**— Begin Forwarded Message —**_

CNN recently ran a story highlighting why Georgia is such a critical state in the fight for abortion rights.

Prior to _Roe v. | Friends,
I would like to congratulate my spectacular running mate, Leah Allen, for her outstanding performance that won this morning's debate for Lieutenant Governor.
Leah wasn't afraid to talk about the tough issues, the subjects that are really affecting Massachusetts families and businesses these days. She spoke eloquently about her work as a Registered Nurse during COVID, and losing her job because she refused to get vaccinated. She spoke about how the Legislature is putting its summer vacation plans ahead of the interests of Massachusetts residents, who could really use a tax break. She talked about the importance of personal freedoms and how we need to not only respect individual rights in the Executive and Legislative branches, but also how we need judges who will enforce the law from the bench.
You can watch a video of Leah's debate here:
---
[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001z1xqd1g-hj6r8k-bu-r8-9BPRtrv9EHnvBxdYMCYOE_uMXhkrKG71mKcKXx_dzHMELNyV-WKKJ5mJrxsH_n9Wz86wvAc-gNTDs2nQcd6YESSjb4xEDvwnZYM53skZMsTNxHGmqdYVgYTc61cIL602Q==&c=l5hjG2k-5T82IByF3Sh8tuYo9DVRYsKezAHVoSoJ7BDt0Ycl7vNwgA==&ch=ApHhpoA8u4w6GK46eI1zggk_lyJxnQK9yohNYEz6HCsAGk2sq9Xz7w==)
---
| I can't wait for Leah Allen to be our next Lieutenant Governor and to work together with her as a team to lead our state forward.
Unfortunately, our opponents in this race are trying to distract attention away from these issues. Leah and I aren't going to let them. There is too much at stake in this race. You, your freedom, and your prosperity are all at stake. Leah and I are singularly focused on making our state a better place to live and work, based on the conservative principles we've both proudly been defending for more than a decade. Our lengthy track record as stalwart conservatives has earned us the endorsement of prominent national Republicans like President Donald Trump and Governor Kristi Noem. It also earned us both convincing wins at the MassGOP Convention in May.
I remain confident voters will agree and support both of us at the Republican primary on September 6.
As always, Leah and I really appreciate your support. Thank you.
---

body:
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zd14i49os3fkf252ukgog0rslh3fr43ktaktvf5g_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9o32c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm8p79d9j6iprect66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uuq34ttimpj7ecjm64ojbcbic9qm8dj2ccon8t73curj8plkc9qr4d71e1qr1ppnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6spm8c3nc5j78o5jc9jr1db5e8iv0)
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zb39e1s5rj6p8ncehc494ebnihafg707i7n1nlu8_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9o32c5h2bs)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvni5c1ps6g69t9mgrds99m88bnv9jih7kvcnpd8_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9o32c5h2bs)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_ .

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zip5kd2jbdbi2mfipt4busqn8nn7h2lsq2ic6puo_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9o32c5h2bs)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zm3pc5hepamueqb9lm968vbbj3nqr2kg2q0f2g28_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9o32c5h2bs)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2void4k4bqg5el1f9e5rpb06qlt9tnnu6hca73o_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9o32c5h2bs) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z76jvje31au5hebrp7jlo8g49po6t6s4jr0ks83g_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9o32c5h2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

PS: Remember – Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me.

[**Will you help me prove that by sending her packing with a $35 or more campaign donation to my primary challenge?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zd4ghck7k0mmqhphfu9umajodgddnau3h9gt1s00_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9o32c5h2bs)

[DONATE](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zn62tre0b2quth5iedb04frkrftmloef4uuc6j38_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9o32c5h2bs)

[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmgj415g874geejpg56k1iruu0nt0i0u6ti8p0eg_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq9dhkumqb7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sjgmkoecpbjeloj8tljcor62cdic5gr2sj4mjgb9o9jmap36d33e9or6cbj64rjfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup70phhmiqj9o3nc5j39o5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc3dk2ip6f1g9uqqr4gei3bcatd96kj7mt6j3tu0_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvdbpk54dm6j69ntrihj3vff0v0v95rpr8tussv0_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6a5gijeukhc331cs7r9lc73jua1mf1ta6sins40_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z66er8amoivs0mte7mmid4pdeb8g1eltsq3ernc0_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkm56ke8m14lk2ldsch4pojtthg1kkolhjt95of8_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2znsaap1csgbecvlj4he0q4qm703j0uijsq9ap9po_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zo0kpa30unl3rpjujc9l81cbvv45ge8pmotgja30_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmd79jgmtktq8q51f7s2eilhjip6tshhkk6h7rg0_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvan2cdv8v9unlvoaffjtsfj1fnsc71eihlj4dsg_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcg49b7ku6udfuscj5m0q3o1b1ng73v2r4h2u8kg_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbdom9p395gmm9nsccesg13m7mh11v7jl33vanao_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpckogd86p3m8ov9n4s3odp8neijdrlgrshhr3o8_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zctmvulbat7i4ivsk3o856as4rf2j53f1jhhfohg_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2obq8k37f6j3lqngo4m3dppvgn2qfql6j5m5u5g_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zp5v9m3sb492iudkjifjrl846jci45hklmf3rjj0_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgr86tce2qkmq3it2adqlkb3ep7a7p7od3njhnuo_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgcoshvfvf6b92tvmrtpkjo9iu6eualofl3d8gbg_rp22sh2s8i66or0clie9p74c9h2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

name: Kristina Karamo
subject: Summer's Heating Up
body:
What a great summer we are having!
More festivals and parades are coming up. More opportunities to introduce Michiganders to their next Secretary of State! Wear your T-shirt and join us as a "walking billboard". We get lots of smiles and have great conversations. You can pass out information, have a discussion, or just smile back.
If you like jazz, join us this weekend at the **free Kimmie Horn Jazz Festival** in Southfield. Friday, August 12 from 6-10:30 p.m. and Saturday, August 13 from 3-10:30 p.m. on the front lawn of the Southfield Municipal Campus, 26000 Evergreen Road. Let us know you're coming [by clicking here.](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/fEsv8aEMpU3ywP2QvPjgFQ/YsFpXqxKaZAfX6GMJn8TVw/u892892vwSBXA3ZDNptJjCf26A)
Milford Memories is always great family fun. Join us as we all enjoy live music and terrific food.
[Join us by clicking here.](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/fEsv8aEMpU3ywP2QvPjgFQ/yWThRHWGGPSMkj3lGDdBsg/u892892vwSBXA3ZDNptJjCf26A)
Can you say CHEEEESEBURGER? Join us up in the thumb for Caseville's famous nod to America's favorite sandwich. The festival goes from August 12th to the 20th, but we'd really like you to be part of the parade. That will be on Wednesday, the 17th at 5:30pm. [ Sign up here](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/fEsv8aEMpU3ywP2QvPjgFQ/rQRjLIale16R9ll0Do7bug/u892892vwSBXA3ZDNptJjCf26A) and we'll send you the specifics on where to meet up.
**On the Horizon:**
America's biggest Cruise. The [Woodward Dream Cruise](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/fEsv8aEMpU3ywP2QvPjgFQ/D9S0763GThL3WBs7jeS59m2w/u892892vwSBXA3ZDNptJjCf26A) will be August 20th
The traditional [Mackinaw Bridge walk](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/fEsv8aEMpU3ywP2QvPjgFQ/mugY0cyEaKDQcz1hLsLe6g/u892892vwSBXA3ZDNptJjCf26A) will be Labor Day, September 5th. We are planning a special gathering afterwards. Mark you calendars.

**_" Remember...SOS Benson isn't a liberal Democrat...she's an Authoritarian Extremist!"_**
[](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/fEsv8aEMpU3ywP2QvPjgFQ/2UkWVEty5mWcsfJuHaFVVQ/u892892vwSBXA3ZDNptJjCf26A)
Support Kristina Karamo
Learn more about me at my website, [KristinaKaramo.com](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/fEsv8aEMpU3ywP2QvPjgFQ/vwVr8K7gY0ESKEkTCpJqzQ/u892892vwSBXA3ZDNptJjCf26A)
Follow me on

We’ve created a free online teaching series that combines the learning of an online course with the features of a documentary.

In this free teaching series, Presidential Medal of Freedom recipient Arthur Laffer—famous for the Laffer Curve and for advising President Ronald Reagan—provides answers to fundamental questions about the core areas of macroeconomics—taxation, money, government spending, regulation, and trade—and how government policies in these areas either promote or hinder the growth of the economy.

In each episode, you’ll learn from Dr. Laffer, as well as:

* **Steve Forbes** , Chairman and Editor-in-Chief of Forbes Media.
* **Stephen Moore** , distinguished fellow in economics at the Heritage Foundation and author, with Art Laffer, of Trumponomics: Inside the America First Plan to Revive Our Economy.
* **Brian Domitrovic** , economic historian and author of Econoclasts: The Rebels Who Sparked the Supply-Side Revolution and Restored American Prosperity.
* **Larry Kudlow** , former Director of the National Economic Council under President Donald Trump.
* **Amity Shlaes** , chair of the board of the Calvin Coolidge Presidential Foundation and best-selling author of The Forgotten Man: A New History of the Great Depression.
* And, **Larry P. Arnn** , President of Hillsdale College.

This free series could not be timelier, given our current economic situation. In this free series, you’ll learn how private citizens drive the economy and you’ll discover the role economic incentives play in unleashing prosperity—timeless lessons in human nature and economics that are common sense to most Americans, but appear lost on many in our academic and political “elite.”

**[So, after watching the trailer, I hope you’ll be one of the first to join us by pre-registering for this free online series.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9afdbdd74100498ba49421ff897acebf&_e=O9yf7LjGGkLSBjHPMUYKrI1s9aPvoacU7jfqALqSdbButBR3j-a8OKl2-rpj2BAi1slm_Ep5rwwReFEen4S8cKzTVDl9r5BGa9Cmrftps0Om05XQFPyocjsPGUBCuHONMYheNkkk8HbFgT9IYy9J_9lqTQ7o9WuvfSB_qeqep2lwceoMHVK4gK1uKU6-b-2hbARe04xMVEfnSGORBw1L0029MdSZrsZpGLzqLJEbaa7B4zy8wZx32OuSrvWHOxsIUSQZLLrrZyXfzNKQ7l-5u6JG_9Kr1D64RihGExomsTInBBiHWm4KqmraA3XCGWech1dxb_UDJGCwLZ7f8AZ3ed29K_I3Vhk7kQgkLOSfq5t1jaIg-eAiEaMHPgk0y2oqzKJXaLRkvmIF5zja17Sa-TXcjyuglqwGh0DWvr1Gpy0C47woWrGbOJpJFI-bkZ_67vJvkxOU4ZKncmShVgkAQ54Hu5I7dwMXvHarpei1a64%3D)**

Americans across the country like you are looking for answers to our current economic condition. But, as Dr. Art Laffer explains, good economic policy is not complicated, and you can learn why.

Pre-register for “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ” today!

Kyle Murnen, ’09

Hillsdale College

subject: The letter I received from Big Pharma
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220815&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220815&amount=28]
Team,
When I’m out on the road, there’s one issue that unites people almost more than any other: lowering the cost of prescription drugs. It’s something I’ve been working on since I was first elected to Congress, and comes from my personal experience caring for my mom when she had ovarian cancer. And it’s reinforced to me every week when someone tells me that they pay more in drug costs per month than their mortgage.
Now, one big piece of that puzzle has been passed into law: allowing Medicare to negotiate the cost of prescription drugs. This very basic idea — that when Medicare buys in bulk it should get a lower per unit price – is in the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) that just passed. The IRA strikes the single sentence, currently in law, that prohibits the country’s biggest insurance health program to use their buying power to get lower prices. In contrast, the military insurance I'm on is allowed to negotiate — but it’s one fifth the size of Medicare.
And – you guessed it – Big Pharma, made up of some of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies, isn’t exactly a fan of this legislation. In fact, my House colleagues and I received a letter threatening anyone who votes in favor of it. To be honest, the pressure is much worse on some of my peers: I don’t take corporate PAC money, so the Pharma industry's threat of pulling all support doesn’t impact me the way those threats are currently chafing others.
In the past, we’ve seen the pharmaceutical industry prop up candidates who support their agenda – and spend huge sums against anyone who tries to stand in their way. So, don’t be surprised if you see some intense spending against me and my colleagues in the coming weeks.
These prescription drug reforms are basic, common sense measures that any American can understand. And it’s about doing the right thing for our seniors who are paying way too much for their life saving drugs. So keep your eyes peeled for the cost of drugs to come down over the next few years!

subject: Sarah Palin’s incoherent rambling at the recent CPAC convention was an awful flashback to the 2008 presidential campaign, and our friend, David Pakman, breaks it down for us.
body:
Mary Peltola for Alaska
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **Sarah Palin’s CPAC appearance was everything we’ve come to expect from her since she stumbled onto the national stage in 2008.** [**Our friend, David Pakman, breaks it down for you on The David Pakman Show, where she tried and failed to make a quote from Abraham Lincoln relevant to whatever it is she was trying to tell us she was mad about.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2ae8a6b0-0fa2-4a0b-98f3-bc35adacc11e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Sarah Palin has run out of reality shows, cheap gimmicks and family values (her husband Todd divorced her a few years ago, accusing her of abuse), reentering a political system she helped debase in 2008 with her casual stupidity and endless conspiracies. [**Can you please join me in supporting Mary Peltola with $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford, and rejecting the hate and lies, once again, of Sarah Palin?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdebbf0a8-41af-488d-9dc0-29c042632bb2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Palin's running for the vacant seat in Congress from Alaska. She was joined by Trump at a rally the very day Mar-a-Lago was raided, and put out the following crass, dishonest and riot-inciting statement (See FBI Building, Cincinnati) in response to the FBI raid to retrieve stolen state secrets----including some on nuclear technology--that Trump may have been selling to our enemies:** _If Palin wins the seat from Alaska, she'll have the large soapbox afforded her by her fame from which to attack our democracy and institutions, weakening the rule of law. It would be like taking Marjorie Taylor Greene or Lauren Boebert and injecting them with steroids. In a few words, Sarah Palin's uniquely dangerous._ Luckily we have a GREAT CHANCE to stop Palin and win this seat. Alaska has a top four primary and a ranked choice general election ballot. Native Alaskan and Democrat Mary Peltola is running for the seat, and if Democrats list her first, and she's listed second on enough ballots by independents and Republicans angry at the other Republicans for attacking their top choice, she can win!

| | Aloha mai kākou, When I served abroad as a US Diplomat, democracy is one of the core tenants of American foreign policy I promoted. **Saturday was democracy in action.** While the results aren’t what we hoped for, I wanted to give my deepest mahalo for all of the time and dedication that my team and all of our wonderful volunteers put in to spread our message of change. Our campaign was a 100 day sprint to the finish line, and I am proud of what we were able to accomplish. The son of a teenage mom and a dad who didn’t finish high school was a competitive candidate for Congress. Only in our Hawai‘i, and in our country, is a story like that possible. After a hard fought campaign, it’s time for Democrats to come together and ensure that we do all that we can to hold this seat. I am fully supporting Jill Tokuda in the general election, and will do whatever she asks of me to help her win in November. **It’s been the honor of my life to meet with residents across our state and earn their trust and aloha.** I have dedicated my life to serving Hawai‘i and our country, and rest assured that I will continue to dedicate everything in me to serving the people of Hawai‘i. Mahalo nui loa, a hui hou and mālama pono, — Pat

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc7a9efqlf6eo60ajvhvhut3ja4h6vtk8dv2adbo_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfaplmeeoeap71ceqebd72mdj64srleerj0or1mhh60t3hmdqj6ptmmdq70otjcsrt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coojecr3cur60phmcsqrcdtgmlin49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj11udbpd9a83oc474dbml5kbckf2epf6oem69ng_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt1ps4h9pmrpqv9qfdp2uo19fo576f92i0noh8io_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdrvpdmvc8gmn9e2cpa5drhhs5h3hff7jsn1fppg_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvnjh283hb4ot6akp5p850vpeclckm2pbircvjag_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsk1sh67cb654rbnmj15jfa10t7qvu6io2e28c2o_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo187c48uh00d22hra13i3528v8615vqtbv9ndlo_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfb9b910qnm0f0ecq4t0gehkoosprgkacem57g10_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zciju5ud9s5dr8ic1qf3c53q7a5146cg9qfm8om0_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9474crp141u7dthn3knavci55bh9gqd14obsjn8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgns4pegcirv42l2nraonbbdaee0m2gsl399cjk8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjv9p2sv08hgi5ljbktha0idk9vp0psbdj71r318_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znt7hehssie9hrn4d1lkh34lfks7r70d50cm1rao_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhqjh7po797uahdfpv0ou0cvpnts2qmt43e9ujbg_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztne7f3e7rh7s2r6agsd72jrekti3khd8qf4dqu8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztien0davvav6efh884aj17fdf19jku843vb3fl8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoskvt0v9eljs6utmna8tqltqo2nerh80ai23kb0_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcgqbh092i493picb7vplaj3fgtbrvu2fjga86g0_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4bqd6ej03o0bph9t7kuuv8ks4jdkplqs8s1h4o8_rp22sh2s8i66or0cdg60o71cph2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

Peter, If you didn’t know, there’s this U.S. tax loophole called the “carried interest loophole” that allows super-rich Wall Street private equity executives to pay about half as much in taxes as regular folks. That means that millionaires and billionaires get to pay *significantly* lower rates than most teachers, nurses, and even truck drivers and retail workers. Here’s why we’re talking about it now: when the Inflation Reduction Act was first unveiled, it took a big step towards finally closing the carried interest loophole. But then that provision was removed. Why? **Because Senator Kyrsten Sinema opposed it.** It’s totally ridiculous. Sinema prioritized keeping the carried interest loophole for her Wall Street donors. And they got what they wanted because they think the public won’t see or won’t care. **That’s why it’s important for you to speak up.** **_[Join thousands of folks signing a joint petition to Sen. Here’s why we’re talking about it now: when the Inflation Reduction Act was first unveiled, it took a big step towards finally closing the carried interest loophole. clean_body: I wanted to introduce myself, Peter. | | | Hi Peter – it's a pleasure to meet you. As of last week, I am officially the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin, and the race to take on Ron Johnson starts now. In order to flip this seat in November, I'm relying on an unprecedented grassroots movement to defeat Ron Johnson. I cannot do this alone. Wisconsin's Senate race is one of the most important races in the entire country this year. Because defending the Democratic Senate majority depends on what happens in Wisconsin. I was born and raised in Milwaukee. I don’t come from a wealthy or well-connected family. But I do come from a proud union family. My mom was a Milwaukee school teacher for 30 years, and my dad worked the 3rd shift at the General Motors plant. Those jobs were my family's ticket to the middle class. My parents spent their days organizing for better wages and advancing workers' rights. Their example showed me the importance of coming together around shared values and fighting for opportunity for everyone. The current system isn't working for people in Wisconsin and across the country. Hard work just isn't paying off like it used to. People are working longer and longer for less and less while big corporations and CEOs bring in larger profits than ever before. That's why we can't settle for what is – we have to reach for what can be. Now that we are up against Ron Johnson , we will be facing some very powerful special interest groups and right-wing super PACs that want to stop our campaign. They will pour tens of millions of dollars into negative ads to try to defeat me and prop up Ron Johnson. The truth is that they will stop at nothing to defend this seat. So we need to be ready for whatever they will throw our way, which means I am relying on lots of people making contributions to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat and defend the Senate majority. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Taking The Hill PAC
body:
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/OLi0XD55Hpd57jBBDPaqs5ZCenXKKXN6TxOa7whZGcM=/vDFgfcKI-brhPIFjrvhx1E31EYHqHtOAWD3xdaXc9zg=)

Friend,

Our Founder Patrick Murphy and Board Chair Dan Kunze are excited to announce that our next event is now less than a month away. On September 14th, from 4:00-5:30 p.m, we will be at The Monocle Restaurant in Washington D.C. The event is in support of our slate of Veteran candidates that includes Chrissy Houlahan, Tammy Duckworth, Mark Kelly, and more ([**RSVP HERE**](https://act.myngp.com/el/OLi0XD55Hpd57jBBDPaqs5ZCenXKKXN6TxOa7whZGcM=/kohTPYEvmewPAT7trJzxqIfcyN8ED8F0vYpK3Ix2DVM=)**)**. Additionally, our Founder and Board Chai are thrilled to introduce our keynote speaker: Senator Jack Reed.

We could not be more honored to be joined by such an iconic guest. Senator Reed has been a stalwart member of the Senate since 1996, and has been a tireless fighter for the people of Rhode Island. Not only is Senator Reed an honorable public servant, but he, and his family story, are prime examples of why we need more veterans in Congress.

[](https://act.myngp.com/el/OLi0XD55Hpd57jBBDPaqs5ZCenXKKXN6TxOa7whZGcM=/kohTPYEvmewPAT7trJzxqIfcyN8ED8F0vYpK3Ix2DVM=)
Senator Reed's father was a WW2 veteran and beneficiary of the GI bill. The program helped him work his way to becoming a custodial supervisor for the city of Cranston's school system. While his wife was a homemaker, she would send one of her sons to West Point.

Jack Reed would graduate from West Point in 1971, and go on to receive Public Policy and Law degrees from Harvard University. In the military, Jack served in the 82nd Airborne Division as an infantry Platoon Leader, a Company Commander, and a Battalion Staff Officer. He would join the faculty at West Point as an Associate Professor, and go on to teach at the U.S Military Academy. In August of 1979, he resigned from active duty with the rank of Captain and would continue serving in the Army Reserves until 1991 when he left with the rank of Major.

Upon graduation from law school, Jack became a private attorney that specialized in banking and securities law before serving three terms in both the Rhode Island State Senate, and as a U.S Representative from Rhode Island. In 1996, Jack Reed was elected to serve as the 46th United States Senator from Rhode Island.

_Time_ magazine describes Senator Reed as "a serious, intellectually honest veteran and an expert on defense issues in the Senate". The _New York Times _notes that he is "a quiet deal-maker respected by colleagues in both parties."

Senator Reed is a senior member of the Appropriations Committee, where he supports clean water projects and improves children's health care. Reed also is the Chairman of the Senate Armed Services Committee. In this role, he is a national leader in the defense and security of our nation--he voted against giving President Bush the authority to go to war in Iraq in 2002. Senator Reed has grown Rhode Island's defense sector, helping lead to the U.S Navy's plans to build their submarines in Rhode Island, bringing thousands of good-paying jobs to the state. He is also a senior member on the Senate Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee, where he authored provisions that secured taxpayers $10 billion in dividends after saving the banks.

[](https://act.myngp.com/el/OLi0XD55Hpd57jBBDPaqs5ZCenXKKXN6TxOa7whZGcM=/kohTPYEvmewPAT7trJzxqIfcyN8ED8F0vYpK3Ix2DVM=)

There is much more to Jack's story, but even in these snapshots of his career, he embodies what Taking The Hill stands and fights for. He is the son of a WW2 veteran, a graduate of West Point, and a former Army Major. Senator Reed has taken his military background and harnessed the values of honesty, integrity, hard work, and leadership that he learned through his service to continue serving his nation in politics. His character is beyond reproach, and a testament to what veterans can do once elected to political public service.

Thank you and we hope to see you join us on September 14th,

Hon. Patrick J. Murphy - Founder
Dan Kunze - Board Chair
Taking the Hill PAC

| **Slotkin Dodges First Debate** After trying to limit the number of debates with Senator Tom Barrett to just two over the remaining three months of the campaign, carpetbagging-Congresswoman Elissa Slotkin refuses to debate Barrett at the invitation of the Lansing Regional Chamber and the Greater Lansing Association of Realtors.“Congresswoman Slotkin recently moved to Lansing and claims its her home, yet she refuses to participate in a debate before two of the most important organizations in the region,” said Senator Barrett, who has represented the Lansing suburbs portions of the city for eight years and didn’t have to move into the district to run.“The Congresswoman plans to hide behind her $10 million campaign war chest and avoid letting voters see behind the facade that she’s a moderate,” continued Barrett. “She’s voted with Joe Biden 100% of the time since he took office, including a vote last week to hire enough IRS agents to fill Spartan Stadium and the Breslin Center and several votes to give billions of taxpayer money to global corporations.”“I’d avoid the voters, too, if I had her record,” said Barrett.The August 1 invite to Senator Barrett is below.

| Dan just passed historic legislation to bring down prices, strengthen our economy, reduce the national deficit and combat climate change. Now, it’s about to be signed into law.

The _Inflation Reduction Act_ will help lower everyday costs for working families. This legislation will:
* Allow Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices with Big Pharma, helping to lower costs
* Cap seniors’ out-of-pocket spending for prescription drugs at no more than $2,000 per year
* Ensure that Medicare patients pay no more than $35 per month out-of-pocket for insulin
* Address inflation by lowering the national deficit
* Combat climate change, strengthen energy security, and create jobs in clean energy sectors including solar panels, wind turbines, and electric vehicle manufacturing
* Calls on the richest corporations to finally pay their fair share of taxes and will not raise taxes by a single penny for anyone making less than $400K per year

These are the results that Dan is getting for us in Congress.

**Every day, Dan is leading the fight to lower costs, protect health care, invest in our domestic manufacturing and our local economies, and make sure working families never get left behind.**

**Meanwhile, his trust fund millionaire opponent came out AGAINST this progress. Dan’s opponent stands with Big Pharma and opposes efforts to lower the cost of prescription drugs. Dan’s opponent opposed making sure corporations pay their fair share because he supports special interest tax breaks for millionaires like himself.**

Make no mistake, the _Inflation Reduction Act_ is a major step forward, and Dan won’t stop fighting to make sure every Michigander and American has a fair shot to get ahead. But this shows just how critical it is that we protect our majority in Congress this November so we can keep working for you.

subject: Tomorrow marks three months out from the general election, Peter.

body:
Every little bit makes a big difference.
Peter - the midterm elections are nearly three months away, and I'm sure your inbox is flooded with emails asking you to donate before "time runs out."

Look, I'm not going to turn this into one of those emails claiming that the "entire election depends on your donation" - because it's simply not true. **But here 's the thing, your support _does_ matter.**

While it may be true that a single donation isn't going to either make or break the outcome of this election, the bottom line is this: **We 're running a people-powered campaign, which means that it's the people - folks like you - who help me keep this campaign afloat. **

The more folks who chip in on emails just like this one, the more resources we'll have to leverage to ensure that I'm able to get my message to folks all across our region.

My team and I are confident about Democrats' chances in November. We've worked hard to prepare, organize, and mobilize voters to cast their ballot on Election Day. But the truth is, with so much at stake, we can't afford to be complacent.

**Cincinnati Fraternal Order of Police Endorse Congressman Chabot for Reelection** _Chabot a Champion for Local Law Enforcement and First Responders_ _ _**For Immediate Release** Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) CINCINNATI – Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign released the following statement Monday on the Congressman’s recent endorsement for reelection by the Cincinnati Fraternal Order of Police: “I have always stood with the men and women of law enforcement and will continue to be a champion for our police, first responders and all those who serve to protect the public safety,” said Congressman Steve Chabot. “I’m incredibly honored to receive this endorsement and look forward to continuing my service as a strong advocate for our men and women in blue and all first responders in Congress.” “My record stands in clear contrast with that of my opponent who has chosen to side with the most radical elements Derek, Our August mid-month deadline is tonight at midnight! name: Jon Kaiman
subject: Kaiman leads conversation on gun violence prevention
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Kaiman for Congress
body:
Peter,
On Wednesday, Jon was privileged to moderate a Gun Violence Prevention Panel at the _" Yes We Can" _Community Center __ in New Cassel, addressing the rising gun violence epidemic within our communities.
He was joined by over 50 neighbors from Westbury/New Cassel and a panel of experts that included Police Commissioner Rodney Harrison; Family and Children's Association President and CEO, Dr. Jeffrey Reynolds; Pediatric Specialist, Dr. Eve Meltzer-Krief; and gun violence survivors Shenee Johnson and Rita Kestenbaum.

As Supervisor of the Town of North Hempstead, Jon opened the _" Yes We Can" _Community Center _ _ in New Cassel. The center provides an opportunity to engage local youth in leadership and team-building activities. Many of these youth attended the Gun Violence Prevention Panel, voicing their concerns on an issue that greatly impacts their lives.

It is important to recognize the effects of all forms of gun violence in our society. Those experiencing everyday gun violence often report feeling excluded from the conversation, as high-profile shootings command the nation's attention.

As your next Congressman, Jon will fight to prioritize community and evidence-based solutions to gun violence and work to pass common sense gun reform measures; including:
* Banning assault weapons
* Restricting open carry
* Closing gun show loopholes
* Investing in community mental health support
* Holding manufacturers responsible
* Enforcing Red Flag Laws
* Standing up to the gun lobby

clean_body: | | | Peter, Mandela Barnes’s victory in Wisconsin last week is proof that people are ready for transformative leadership that works for working people. But our work is about more than just any one race — it’s about building a movement and creating a political home, a community of regular people coming together across our differences to make a better future for us all. And we want you to be part of it. Tonight, Monday, August 15 at 8 PM ET/5 PM PT, join the WFP Welcome Gathering featuring Wisconsin WFP and Nada Elmikashfi! This is your chance to learn more about the work we’re doing in Wisconsin and across the country and how you can get involved. Whether you’re a new supporter or a longtime WFP member, welcome gatherings are an energetic space where you can meet other working people with the same vision of building a world where we can thrive, and not just survive. We’ll share our desires and vision for a political party that truly is for us and by us. We’ll get concrete about how we are building the power we need to have an impact locally and nationally in this political moment. And we can help you sort out a meaningful next step with the party. With 85 days until the midterm elections, we’ve got work to do. Mandela has a close race ahead of him, with Cook Political report rating this race as a “toss up.”1 In 85 days, we have a chance to replace Ron Johnson with someone who’s ready to fight climate change, create good jobs, expand access to high-quality, affordable childcare and so much more. Peter, it’s not hyperbole to say that the control of the U.S. Senate and the fate of our entire progressive agenda is dependent upon winning this election. Join us tonight for the Welcome Gathering at 8 PM ET/5 PM PT to learn more about our plan to win in November, as well as in upcoming primaries like next Tuesday’s in New York, and figure out the best way for you to get involved. Running to defeat NRCC Chair GOP U.S. Rep. Tom Emmer

Friends,
**I'm Jeanne****Hendricks** , a nurse anesthetist, mom and the**Democratic nominee for U.S. Congress in Minnesota's 6th** , and I'm running to defeat the National Republican Congressional Committee Chair and U.S. Rep. Tom Emmer.
As Chair of the NRCC, U.S. Rep. Tom Emmer is committed to electing anti-choice and anti-gun safety Republican congressional candidates. His job is to lead the effort to defeat Democratic congressional incumbents around the country in order to take back the U.S. House for the Republican Party. He is also committed to helping re-elect candidates like U.S. Reps. Matt Gaetz, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Lauren Boebert.
Jeanne Hendricks' opponent, Rep. Tom Emmer, supports making all abortions illegal, as well as putting women into prison for having a life-saving abortion, for obtaining one because of rape or incest, or for traveling out of state to receive an abortion. Yes, Rep. Emmer is that extreme. [Click here for Tom Emmer's position on abortion.](https://l2political.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00b18e7544dd3ec267591c592&id=13f77fec19&e=dae5afbbad) **As Congresswoman, I will fight to codify Roe into law.**
GOP U.S. Rep. Tom Emmer voted NO on the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. **I would have voted YES on the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act.** Over 300 mass shootings have been committed since the start of 2022. Recently, a gunman in Highland Park, Illinois killed eight and left nearly 30 injured during an Independence Day parade. Tom Emmer also voted NO against funding and additional resources being provided to communities to stop mass shootings from happening again. Even more insultingly, Rep. Emmer serves as a member of the Mental Health Caucus in the U.S. House of Representatives. Yet he voted NO on the bipartisan bill that would increase investments in children and family mental health services and for schools. He voted NO against the very mission of a caucus that he serves in.
---
**I have been on the frontlines fighting for and defending our Democracy by speaking with and hearing the concerns of the people. Here are my priorities for the people of Minnesota's 6th:**
* Defend our Democracy and protect the right to vote.
* Strongly support Minnesota’s farmers and working families.
* Provide quality health care for all and lower prescription drug prices for our senior citizens and Minnesotan families.
* Honor our veterans by increasing funding to the Veterans Administration and provide our military veterans with mental health care when needed.
* Protect women’s rights and women’s health care decisions.
* Address climate change to further reduce carbon emissions to protect our environment.
* Pass more common-sense gun safety legislation, now, to protect our families and children. The Bipartisan Safer Communities Act was a good start, but we need to do more.
* Strongly support our local law enforcement officers and fully fund police reform to end systemic inequities in our society.

**Go to[www.hendricks2022.com](https://l2political.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00b18e7544dd3ec267591c592&id=0c1cf47218&e=dae5afbbad) to learn more about our campaign.**
When elected, I will land it for the people of Minnesota's 6th!
**[Can our campaign count on you to make a donation of $50, $20.22, $10, $5, $1, or another amount today to help us defeat NRCC Chair and GOP U.S. Rep. Tom Emmer?](https://l2political.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00b18e7544dd3ec267591c592&id=d91341f862&e=dae5afbbad)**

name: Gavin Newsom for Governor
subject: One of those days
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY NEWSOM FOR CALIFORNIA – GOVERNOR – 2022
body:
As you know, California is a large and expensive state when it comes to elections.

friends -
Today is one of those days we have to ask you directly to make a contribution to Gavin Newsom’s re-election campaign.
Let us be as honest as we can about why this request is so important.
As you know, California is a large and expensive state when it comes to elections.
And our job is to turn out as many Democrats as we possibly can in every part of this state.
We need to turn them out to re-elect Governor Newsom.
We need to turn them out to pass a constitutional amendment protecting abortion rights in California.
We need to turn them out because it could be the difference in close local races far-right Republicans are trying to win.

# Hey Team Brooke!
Brett here- Brooke's trusted campaign manager.

I wanted to echo the words that I said at Saturday evening's potluck event for those who were unable to make it.

Let me give refresh you with some quick statistics:

In the primary election, we were outspent by exactly $4,217.37. The result? _**We received the most votes out of any candidate on the ballot for District 2B- Democrat or Republican**_. That's Brooke's momentum for you!

That being said, we unfortunately expect to be outspent again in the general. The current delegate has already received thousands of dollars from her party leaders in Annapolis. **Unlike her, we have to rely on YOU to keep this campaign running.**

Of course, money doesn't buy votes, but it does help us get the word out. Signs, mailers, door hangers, ads, events, etc. In the primary election, Brooke's hard work combined with my management efficiency (yes, I get to brag a little sometimes) put our cost per vote at $3.07.

_**It took $3.07 of signs, mailers, and door hangers to get out a vote.**_ That's pretty damn efficient, and that's why you should donate to us. I personally promise that every dollar you trust me with will be stretched so far that we can walk on it to Annapolis.

Think about it: if you donate just $20, and you already plan to vote for Brooke yourself, of course, you just SEXTUPLED your voting power by giving me the resources to energize 6 more people to hit the polls. If you donate $50 or $100, the numbers get even bigger.

So, once again, thanks for your continued support. I hope you consider donating so we can keep up this fight!

Peter, my campaign team keeps emailing you.

I asked Charlie, my Political Director, to email you.

Even my dad, Willie, sent an email to you.

_They've all explained why this is so important_. I'll explain one more time — your $3 contribution:

**(1)** Supports our digital ads and yard signs,
**(2)** Lets us have conversations with Democratic voters on the ground,
**(3)** And even helps us support other struggling, competitive Democrats up and down the ballot!

Team,

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: I'm asking for your help today
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

I’m writing to you today because things are getting tough at a critical
time. Here’s the situation:

Our fundraising has decreased nearly every month this year. Our
fundraising is down 14% just this month. This is not a sustainable trend
as we try to not just re-elect the Squad, but grow it by sending Summer
Lee and Greg Casar to Congress.

We operate on a pretty tight budget, especially compared to other
political organizations. It’s because we run solely on donations from
grassroots supporters like you. We don’t take a cent from corporate PACs.

Our average donation this year is just $18.24. We’re incredibly proud of
that number. It means we rely on a lot of small-dollar donations to fuel
our primaries.

You may know by now, but we started Justice Democrats after many of us
worked on the Bernie 2016 campaign. We were all inspired and determined to
find a way to continue the message of Bernie’s campaign through electing a
new Congress that truly represented the needs of the people.

That’s when we launched Justice Democrats and supported a lot of
candidates in our first election year (2018). We lost a bunch of races,
but then we won one big one: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s groundbreaking
victory against the 4th most powerful Democrat in the House.

We recruited and elected Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman in 2020, defeating
two more powerful corporate Democrats. This year, we’ve already helped
Summer Lee, Greg Casar, Rashida Tlaib, and Cori win their primaries. Now,
we have to ensure Jamaal wins his primary, we send the Squad back to
Congress, and elect Summer and Greg to join them. We’re working to build
support in Congress for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and so much
more.

That’s why I’m asking,
Peter: can you make
your first donation
to Justice Democrats today?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113370?refcode=em20220815-24737&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=24737%2E1203867%2EIFE53G ]→ Yes, I can donate today to help build the Justice Democrats bloc in
Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113370?refcode=em20220815-24737&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=24737%2E1203867%2EIFE53G ]Contribute

I appreciate so, so much whatever you can give today, whether it’s $3,
$27, $100 or anything at all. We will never take corporate PAC money and
we will always rely on our grassroots movement.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director
Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220815-24737-footer&t=1004&refcode2=24737_1203867_IFE53G&akid=24737%2E1203867%2EIFE53G

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. body:
Today marks one year since Biden's catastrophic Afghanistan withdrawal.

| [ ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=afghan_disaster&n=1)
---
Friend -- **Today** , we remember the one-year anniversary of Biden’s catastrophic Afghanistan withdrawal. [**@RNCResearch**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8TiV2ExMvy-B9xlTsmD5RGJpo7Kd1TnyCXsFiL5hBC_RRJ9BYwGb1Sb33PHa0W5i3pphgTtsVEB4Ol0jSXfXEl05UGHz9xb-BBkGwievKaMTc&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=afghan_disaster&n=2) A year ago today, disaster struck in Afghanistan at the hands of the Biden administration. The U.S. Embassy in Kabul was evacuated, leaving the capital to fall to the Taliban. Billions of dollars worth of U.S. military equipment was placed in the hands of terrorists, the Taliban took over the country, and 13 U.S. service members were killed. [**@derrickvanorden**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8TgNWwpKPbyTckMlS8O0IzC20UxlGC0adEafDASg3Kmo3xh73HiqcTueYNJpCO4EHZ6YbP8zCicu9y2GP79D4EZF_TwUYmTsDlum6oqfdt72Z&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=afghan_disaster&n=3) Not only was the withdrawal abysmally planned and executed, but the Biden Administration repeatedly lied to the American people about what was really going on overseas. As we watched one of the most horrific foriegn policy crises in American history unfold, Biden promised against chaos, pledged the U.S. embassy would not be abandoned, and vowed to protect Americans. **He failed on every front.** **Today, we take a moment to remember the 13 lives lost and the countless left behind. We must never forget this failure by the Biden Administration – and we must send patriots like Ron Johnson and Derrick Van Orden back to Washington to fight back against Biden’s failed foreign policy agenda.** | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=VsLgeNFrtuHusRivV19v3aCXxtdEYxug7BpyM8N6AZw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=afghan_disaster&n=4 "VOLUNTEER") [VOLUNTEER](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=VsLgeNFrtuHusRivV19v3aCXxtdEYxug7BpyM8N6AZw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=afghan_disaster&n=4)
---

body:
This bill is important progress.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220815-3297-header&t=1&akid=3297%2E2526796%2EJOzj2b)
On Friday, Congress officially passed the Inflation Reduction Act – a sweeping tax, health, and climate bill.
President Biden is expected to sign the bill soon, so we wanted to take a moment to share with you what’s in the bill and answer some FAQs.
While this bill isn’t perfect, there’s many significant wins that were only possible as a direct result of your advocacy and support.
**What will the IRA do for the climate?**
👩🏼🔬 Create up to 9 million jobs in clean energy, clean manufacturing, and green transportation
🌎 Reduce greenhouse gasses by 40% by 2030
💰 Dedicate $60 billion for environmental justice in communities hardest hit by climate change and fossil fuels
**How will this bill impact health care costs?**
🛑 Restrict insulin costs to $35 per month for Medicare recipients
📉 Cap out-of-pocket costs for medications to a maximum of $2,000 per year for seniors (down from the current $10,000+ a year for the costliest drugs)
⚖️ Allow Medicare to negotiate lower prices on some prescription drugs for seniors on Medicare starting in 2026
**What are the tax implications?**
👨👩👧👦 No new taxes on any family making $400,000 or less, and no new taxes on small businesses (despite the lies Republicans are spewing)
💵 A 15% minimum tax rate on the wealthiest corporations
📈 1% tax on stock buybacks used to enrich wealthy shareholders
**What’s next?**
We've got lots of work ahead of us. We will continue to build our power for more bold climate action, Medicare for All, and a Green New Deal.
But affirming each step along the path is important. This was the biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change by Congress, and there were many steps along the way where it appeared this bill may not pass at all. **Not only did it pass, but it passed with key investments in climate justice and green jobs – both core principles of the Green New Deal.**
Thank you for all of your support and activism that’s gotten us to this point.
Team AOC
