clean_body: This bill is important progress. On Friday, Congress officially passed the Inflation Reduction Act – a sweeping tax, health, and climate bill. President Biden is expected to sign the bill soon, so we wanted to take a moment to share with you what’s in the bill and answer some FAQs. While this bill isn’t perfect, there’s many significant wins that were only possible as a direct result of your advocacy and support. What will the IRA do for the climate? 👩🏼🔬 Create up to 9 million jobs in clean energy, clean manufacturing, and green transportation 🌎 Reduce greenhouse gasses by 40% by 2030 💰 Dedicate $60 billion for environmental justice in communities hardest hit by climate change and fossil fuels How will this bill impact health care costs? 🛑 Restrict insulin costs to $35 per month for Medicare recipients 📉 Cap out-of-pocket costs for medications to a maximum of $2,000 per year for seniors (down from the current $10,000+ a year for the costliest drugs) ⚖️ Allow Medicare to negotiate lower prices on some prescription drugs for seniors on Medicare starting in 2026 What are the tax implications? 👨👩👧👦 No new taxes on any family making $400,000 or less, and no new taxes on small businesses (despite the lies Republicans are spewing) 💵 A 15% minimum tax rate on the wealthiest corporations 📈 1% tax on stock buybacks used to enrich wealthy shareholders What’s next? We've got lots of work ahead of us. We will continue to build our power for more bold climate action, Medicare for All, and a Green New Deal. But affirming each step along the path is important. This was the biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change by Congress, and there were many steps along the way where it appeared this bill may not pass at all. Not only did it pass, but it passed with key investments in climate justice and green jobs – both core principles of the Green New Deal. Thank you for all of your support and activism that’s gotten us to this point. Team AOC | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

I was there for the dinner on Friday night at the Mission Inn Resort, but my RINO opponent, Daniel Webster, who traditionally attends, skipped out just like he skipped the votes on the January 6th Commission and the second impeachment of President Trump.

Webster has been all-but-absent on the campaign trail and during his 10 years in Congress.

**Where 's Webster?**

As a member of Congress, Do-Nothing Dan has an obligation to earn his government paycheck.

The man has had a DECADE to make an impact, and he has failed miserably!

**That 's why Webster has to go,** and I will be making up for 10 years of lost work for my constituents!

**With EIGHT DAYS left until the Florida Republican Primary,[I really need all the support I can get to win!](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/X5vcW7hWfKOBX7FqtetxLA/OYSogk8kDVSPerzfrwLGLg)**

Early voting is underway and ends in five days, and I have volunteers manning the early voting locations while we continue to knock on doors and reach every Republican voter in the district.

But this comes at a cost: gas, water, tents to keep staff out of the Florida sun, sample ballots, yard signs and palm cards. And that's just a FRACTION of our costs to reach voters!

[Will you chip in with just eight days to go?](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/X5vcW7hWfKOBX7FqtetxLA/OYSogk8kDVSPerzfrwLGLg)

[Please donate all that you can afford today,](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/X5vcW7hWfKOBX7FqtetxLA/OYSogk8kDVSPerzfrwLGLg) and thank you so much for your support.

Thanks so much,

Laura Loomer

_ **Thousand Oaks, CA** \- Matt Jacobs, Federal Prosecutor and Republican nominee for U.S. Congress in California’s 26th District **calls on Rep. Julia Brownley to participate in a series of debates this fall, including the debate being planned by the Ventura County League of Women Voters.**
---
---
Earlier this month, Jacobs attended a “Meet the Candidates” forum hosted by several Ventura County agricultural groups. This was the first opportunity for voters to hear jointly from both candidates. But Rep. Brownley declined to attend. _**“I call on Rep. Brownley to end her ‘basement campaign’ and agree to a series of public debates.** It’s about respect for voters and the democratic process. The people of this community deserve to know where we stand on the issues,”_ **Jacobs said.** _“I look forward to contrasting my commonsense approach to addressing the issues facing our community and country with Rep. Brownley’s record of failure and neglect. Her votes have led to rampant inflation, record-high gas and food prices, the release of violent criminals, and dismal educational outcomes for so many children. All the while, Rep. Brownley has falsely claimed to be an ‘independent voice’ for Ventura County, while voting 100% of the time with her party’s leadership. _ _“Voters deserve the opportunity to hear from both candidates in a neutral, nonpartisan forum so that they can decide for themselves who will best serve our community in Congress.”_ **###** **About Matt Jacobs -** Born and raised in Ventura County, Matt Jacobs devoted his career to serving our country and keeping our community safe. name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: Why I created the BLEXIT Foundation
body:
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=41444cd849894be289b4d3b8db0f6411&_e=401vAapyVK23UX3vDMV78_kdGbnhMGx0VogzQMr7Jt9YNT025ni2JSjSuwrBNzAKX-2vPQAfd3pnh1nM9tOhJ_glbWfHmcr3PtzRzJz1BRYgenTBxQ5XawnCLMHIVfTJ7BXGTB-mOBLve_FGT-7ILjKa3yLzdAoI8GfGIlmnQRspUl7URJLT7Wm8rHBThEWFlWcAJLKJtf-yXeYjA7e_v2dHwTMP3T-4DznWJ_nCAL7CLIrZkcVD3FbA9ir4T8kAnLitIl89ucyvquUPeln2y9g7U7Zxj4DcOfnxNjcbhpitUEvo3a44aAYsLHP-XklmKMqjDCXJ0Doje0pBXhldjZs8_BWvOYLT1t3VVyqNapU%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=41444cd849894be289b4d3b8db0f6411&_e=401vAapyVK23UX3vDMV78_kdGbnhMGx0VogzQMr7Jt9YNT025ni2JSjSuwrBNzAKX-2vPQAfd3pnh1nM9tOhJ_glbWfHmcr3PtzRzJz1BRYgenTBxQ5XawnCLMHIVfTJ7BXGTB-mOBLve_FGT-7ILvDpMltAM3HEmcqGnZeyb9pbQUB89XfIvhowszeUQfdhakV-AcrumnzqLlqRqnMnTGTgWmWIEBRnREbe-uWjB0-OWf3B1NxnO7ymtJ9-TobZBwIhV2zqWYm4fyHTYg5xGrZry3Pb-LsY9LsNCcoFqDuJHTpHGJyGC3ww-PapWKdXSNrflJN-va5_TArd8to-AqSiIeca-mIGxPTn6bpdCNs%3D)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=41444cd849894be289b4d3b8db0f6411&_e=401vAapyVK23UX3vDMV78_kdGbnhMGx0VogzQMr7Jt9YNT025ni2JSjSuwrBNzAKX-2vPQAfd3pnh1nM9tOhJ_glbWfHmcr3PtzRzJz1BRYgenTBxQ5XawnCLMHIVfTJ7BXGTB-mOBLve_FGT-7ILkskXCEllndGytIKNZEVAoAs_Z9kR8K1pkp0Xma6KPtIRv9F6D07zikIDlWrhoA__GhjnxE-QuY646nkmTxN1O06LdJD9aZOq84Mx99CBgfcVyamQ5DSsojJraU2uqcuzHGCvGc_QGISSxyGHftO_uVgZRzt0EtprPVMSmlXOZc4Qn9QGc7PMAu_JtmtQvw08s8QTqQwGgbsN3H0kASh_Z4%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=41444cd849894be289b4d3b8db0f6411&_e=401vAapyVK23UX3vDMV78_kdGbnhMGx0VogzQMr7Jt9YNT025ni2JSjSuwrBNzAKX-2vPQAfd3pnh1nM9tOhJ_glbWfHmcr3PtzRzJz1BRYgenTBxQ5XawnCLMHIVfTJ7BXGTB-mOBLve_FGT-7ILl6yM-cvYEK0nZhnVRM4fklApPx1cCd2BafJK6Sfrlpeq-uSymDpZKYT-LWQll8aoLVtEorpNFWRqEoNInCOxpVtNc8OTZe7irCLEB2IJtpUKj6R8O5Fa_pwwu_PhF37zoGlw6Dl5GItyB2k9DHGj598iOa4RpKATfV-GTHAzYu8622cOo-eYrShkrEdWX3mpQ4iPKUcpPlKmeDIdcwHDYc%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=41444cd849894be289b4d3b8db0f6411&_e=401vAapyVK23UX3vDMV78_kdGbnhMGx0VogzQMr7Jt9YNT025ni2JSjSuwrBNzAKX-2vPQAfd3pnh1nM9tOhJ_glbWfHmcr3PtzRzJz1BRYgenTBxQ5XawnCLMHIVfTJ7BXGTB-mOBLve_FGT-7ILpAMG-UzT1wKfiZOBSBmI9Gve9VhJYsUEcsYTroo8Kr1IKWIHUeHvoC8rXBPmOEKrvmT_L77QPRtb963OyOBKLriIikzlXY7YF_X0qDCEH5rKotNe6B1_rHEKtPRJ7OG1ouqBVXPlVVq6HtHiVqceLsm1UAnBNDYp_TMfUbq_pv1HYFBNrUmoHUYM2NFBWFk-ByP0vHFMywVMzNwvATf0C4%3D)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. clean_body: Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I’ll share my story ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I’ve dealt with racism... I’ve even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I’m not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. In a few words, Sarah Palin's uniquely dangerous._ Luckily we have a GREAT CHANCE to stop Palin and win this seat. Alaska has a top four primary and a ranked choice general election ballot. name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5cfb5e40b93e4017a37d46291943929c&_e=AOpM4BPjqfnMYMGkbgZpv1EwM8ykxTQEMzjspACKSPyQYPCVjnTUxVuGEQEn2Eb2u2AuBvOYdPd_Q5VYwqJR0wZLrYV_mJXBgXg9GEb4HOHr4I_o7507fWrr3iM-j7BEQf-k1O27tpwmyvngmIWHxoeSj_PxH41CDctAFEyD889685QSTmxc_jMhVjpBffAqhvDRB3j18IpQNZmRfzJtNSqpc9RxotaIWC5cn-hAxA6BW6kjib1U4HrBCeeTicxpaXdV6tq8sOUY_UsuYI1DRUJo_vDIICOQiDU0wy320DmmciTRetZ19ia0ZAbKCJIWnmDADyWHU-RJ1TanEeDDuOz9PWbkhHdz7Qqs0pHSsJc%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5cfb5e40b93e4017a37d46291943929c&_e=AOpM4BPjqfnMYMGkbgZpv1EwM8ykxTQEMzjspACKSPyQYPCVjnTUxVuGEQEn2Eb2u2AuBvOYdPd_Q5VYwqJR0wZLrYV_mJXBgXg9GEb4HOHr4I_o7507fWrr3iM-j7BEQf-k1O27tpwmyvngmIWHxhduXl8sORf9PwMQkCpaae19CIk8O9Gg2gdho6vGGbUD9mpDm92B6Vbi9JxydgNxevgeO3wBiY8JpYLAKiI1WOVBHiCzBh7Jz5kkJvxJSOGT3kxEw4YcNBpnKQZ4D3ANINH1eewQdySAPPiW3Z-VVR3f-jfkC-nEMbtlkCpTw4bWyQnqA6CjI2FfCNbcSz_XNCCacpyMivZODX6YVqCtzAE%3D)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5cfb5e40b93e4017a37d46291943929c&_e=AOpM4BPjqfnMYMGkbgZpv1EwM8ykxTQEMzjspACKSPyQYPCVjnTUxVuGEQEn2Eb2u2AuBvOYdPd_Q5VYwqJR0wZLrYV_mJXBgXg9GEb4HOHr4I_o7507fWrr3iM-j7BEQf-k1O27tpwmyvngmIWHxl7Y6rMtTu3AA8ys77QSnl93-WW_kE8bvEX_qsWAfDNmj-rNS-_0_KsW_1-34Bu2S8RqUg2l3j9W6wGk09_Xp6Dog_80NvufjHgpcH8_mEavzTS8TdHU__7gfa0aBJAi6flm_B498VyR6NpPcvEbRAum5zlFedpBjKroV6_HoH00PyBH2KECyhpXuHy5QamFbpqZW_vinaw1LQ0EAU6rEo0%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

We have a major fundraising deadline at midnight, and let me tell you why I’m particularly focused on that.
November 8th is the midterm election. House candidates including me here in California and across the country will be appearing on the ballot for the first time in our new districts. In just 85 days, millions of new voters who have never seen us on their ballots before will go to choose among Democrats and Republicans to decide who will control the U.S. House of Representatives and Senate, along with many important gubernatorial, judicial, state legislative, and state executive races.

| We're excited to come together this **Wednesday, August 17 from 6pm - 8:30pm at Dr. Scofflaw's @ The Works in West Midtown** to say thank you to our first responders.
Our current list of speakers are:

**Christian Zimm** , Candidate for the 5th Congressional District
**Congressman Barry Loundermilk** of the 11th District
**Jodi Diodati** , Candidate for State House District 90
We will also welcome first responders to speak.

_Location_ : Dr. Scofflaw's at The Works (214 Chattahoochee Row NW, Atlanta, GA 30318). The event is **NOT** at "Scofflaw Brewery", make sure to have the correct location in the navigation.

_Directions_ : The Main Entrance into the complex is closed due to construction, so enter in the marked side on Makers Way NW. We have a private room on the side for an event.

_Time_ : Doors open at 6pm, speaking begins at 6:30pm.

_Parking_ : We recommend parking in the parking deck in the back of the complex.

_Dress code_ : Business casual or casual

_Food & Beverages_: We will be bringing Chick Fil A for food, and there is plenty of drinks available at the venue.

This event will be a reception with drinks followed by speaking from our special guests. We are also co-hosting with the Buckhead Young Republicans.

There will be many first responders present as well as foundations and organizations that support them. We want to give the community an opportunity to show our appreciation for what they do each day for us and find ways we can get more involved to support them.

We are looking for individuals willing to become a Host or Sponsor for this event to support our campaign for Congress. Please contact us at 404-360-7150 if you are interested.

See you there!

I truly believe that, without our campaign then, our campaign today, and activists across the country -- especially young people -- highlighting this existential issue, we would have much less to celebrate today.
